additional_info.subject: RE: 0410669 - ID0410669-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R5 170002027] Plugit- Missing converter in group 1 and 4 CRM:00641001181
additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
I hope this message finds you well.
Regarding the reported issue, it has been observed that a "Missing Converter" error in DC1 and DC4 has occurred, along with error CanCommLoss,
In such cases, the converter wiring might be loose. We recommend verifying the connections with the help of the troubleshooting document.
If all the wiring is properly secured, it is likely that one of the converters may be faulty or damaged. (Power converter[8 and 9]
The converter reporting the issue to the SCB is likely the one that needs replacement or further investigation.
Kindly refer the attached troubleshooting document so trace out the issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
and please ensure to carry a spare converter and CAN communication wire in case a replacement is required.
Spare part converter-: 8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2-Power Converter AC/DC 20kW
For future reference, your ticket number is
ID0410669
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
